newsitem.title: INDIA: India says 97/98 defence outlay 356.20 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India says 97/98 defence outlay 356.20 bln rupees.

text.p: India said on Friday it would increase defence spending in 1997/98 (April-March) to 356.20 billion rupees from 294.98 billion rupees in the previous fiscal year.

Of the increase in defence spending, 36.20 billion rupees would be to provide for pay hikes recommended by a government pay commission, Finance Minister P. Chidambaram told parliament while presenting the budget for 1997/98.

He said capital expenditure on defence -- the component that accounts for arms purchases -- had been provided 89.07 billion rupees in 1997/98, 4.02 bilion rupees more than the latest estimate for 1996/97.
"I make that solemn undertaking here -- that any additional requirement for defence for capital expenditure will be adequately provided for during the course of the year," the minister said.
